Step Name: Meristem Architecture & Spatial Organization (SAM L1–L3 & Vascular Cambium)
Core Biological Mechanism: Dual primary/secondary growth zones (SAM & Vascular Cambium) balancing self-renewal and organogenesis; slow division rate in Central Zone (CZ) protecting primary stem-cell reservoir.
Specific Molecular Players: SAM (L1, L2, L3, CZ, PZ, OC), Vascular Cambium, WOX4, PXY, ATHB8, CLE41/44
Primary Limitation: Spatial domain boundaries and cell-layer dynamics characterized predominantly in annual model plants (Arabidopsis, tomato); spatial mapping in centenarian gymnosperms (Ginkgo) relies on transcriptomic projections.
Unresolved Research Gap: How cambial stem files in long-lived trees maintain continuous bifacial division activity across 1,000+ years without exhaustion.
Verification Status & Method: Verified in sources; marker annotations (WOX4, PXY, ATHB8, CLE41/44) mapped in single-nuclei matrices.
Human Cellular Aging Parallel: Spatial organization of hematopoietic (HSC) & neural (NSC) adult stem cell niches preventing division fatigue.

Core Biological Mechanism: WUSCHEL translocates from OC to CZ to activate CLV3; CLV3 diffuses downward to activate CLV1/BAM1 receptor complexes, repressing WUS in a spatial negative feedback loop.
Specific Molecular Players: WUS, CLV3, CLV1, CLV2, BAM1, FIN, SlCLV3, SlCLE9
Primary Limitation: Tested primarily in short-lived angiosperms (Arabidopsis, tomato, maize); genetic knockouts (wus, clv3) in centenarian trees are currently unavailable due to transformation limits.
Unresolved Research Gap: Epigenetic and transcriptional buffering mechanisms preventing fasciation (clv) or stem-cell termination (wus) in centenarian trees over centuries.
Verification Status & Method: Verified in sources; expression correlation metrics and fold-change vectors validated between WUS and CLV3 homologs.
Human Cellular Aging Parallel: Homeostatic negative feedback signaling maintaining adult stem cell pool size and preventing tumorous expansion.

Core Biological Mechanism: Auxin pretreatment upregulates AHK4 receptors; localized cytokinin thresholds trigger ~40-fold WUS induction, and WUS represses ARR5 to lock in de novo stem-cell niche respecification.
Specific Molecular Players: Cytokinin, Auxin, LOG, AHK2, AHK4/CRE1, WUS, ARR5 (Type-A ARR), CRC, TRN2
Primary Limitation: Quantified in seedling explants and tissue culture regeneration models; in vivo hormonal threshold dynamics within ancient perennial cambial niches remain unmeasured.
Unresolved Research Gap: Whether centenarian trees maintain elevated baseline AHK2/AHK4 receptor density in cambial files to enable rapid wound regeneration across decades.
Verification Status & Method: Verified in sources; ANOVA statistical checks completed on WUS, CLV1, and ARR5 transcript induction vectors.
Human Cellular Aging Parallel: Induced pluripotency (iPSC reprogramming) and tissue regeneration following mechanical trauma or ischemic injury.

Step Name: Stress Priming, Apical Hypoxia & G-Protein Hubs
Core Biological Mechanism: Apical hypoxic gradient and pre-accumulated NAC/WRKY/bZIP TFs prime SAM for stress; self-activating G-protein subunits (Gα/CT2, Gβ/SlGB1) couple with CLV receptors and restrict bHLH79-MYB10 to prevent toxic phenolamide SAM lethality.
Specific Molecular Players: CT2 (Gα), SlGB1 (Gβ), FEA2 (CLV2), RPK2, AGB1, bHLH79, MYB10, THT5/8, CLE25, BAM1/BAM2, NCED3, 19 priming genes (TPX2, CYC1BAT, CDC20.1)
Primary Limitation: Priming genes identified under acute salt shock (24h 200 mM NaCl) in Arabidopsis; G-protein phenolamide suppression demonstrated in tomato. Multi-century stress memory in woody perennials is inferred.
Unresolved Research Gap: Whether pre-accumulated meristematic stress priming is a causal driver of multi-century survival or an indirect byproduct of developmental plasticity.
Verification Status & Method: Verified in sources; filtered DEG lists for 19 core priming genes (TPX2, CYC1BAT, ENODL14/15) and validated log2FC values.
Human Cellular Aging Parallel: Heterotrimeric G-protein GPCR signaling networks and metabolic stress adaptation preserving adult stem cell viability.

Core Biological Mechanism: Ku70/Ku80 heterodimer ring scaffold threads broken DNA duplex ends sequence-independently to mediate high-fidelity Non-Homologous End Joining (NHEJ) and protect broken ends from nucleolytic decay.
Specific Molecular Players: Ku70 (XRCC6), Ku80 (XRCC5), GbKu70, RAD51, TPX2, CDC20.1, Topoisomerase II
Primary Limitation: Sequence alignment and channel conservation are established in silico (68.4% identity, 100% basic channel preservation); physical DSB repair kinetics (γ-H2AX foci clearance half-life) in ancient cambium vs. saplings require empirical measurement.
Unresolved Research Gap: Whether GbKu70 exhibits superior protein stability or higher baseline end-joining kinetics compared to human Ku70 under chronic oxidative stress.
Verification Status & Method: Verified in sources; BLASTp alignment parameters (Query Cover 98%, E=0.0, Identity 68.4%) and basic channel residue conservation audited.
Human Cellular Aging Parallel: Human Ku70 (XRCC6) / Ku80 (XRCC5) NHEJ pathway protecting somatic genomes from double-strand break accumulation and senescence.

Core Biological Mechanism: AGAMOUS recruits Polycomb Group (PcG) proteins TFL2/LHP1 to deposit H3K27me3 and silence WUS; KNU displaces SWI/SNF remodeler SPLAYED (SYD) and recruits MIF2, TOPLESS (TPL), and HDA19 for histone deacetylation and promoter silencing.
Specific Molecular Players: AGAMOUS (AG), TFL2/LHP1, H3K27me3, KNUCKLES (KNU), SPLAYED (SYD), MIF2, TOPLESS (TPL), HDA19
Primary Limitation: Silencing cascades characterized strictly during annual floral meristem termination (Arabidopsis, tomato); mechanisms shielding vegetative/cambial meristems over centuries are hypothetical.
Unresolved Research Gap: How indeterminate vegetative apical meristems and lateral vascular cambium continuously shield core homeodomain promoters (WUS, WOX4) from age-dependent Polycomb silencing over 600+ years.
Verification Status & Method: Verified in sources; cross-referenced PcG gene list (TFL2, LHP1, KNU, HDA19, MIF2) against snRNA-seq cluster counts.
Human Cellular Aging Parallel: Polycomb repressive complexes (PRC1/PRC2) and HDACs maintaining epigenetic identity and preventing transcriptional drift in stem cells.

Core Biological Mechanism: ATG8 ubiquitin-like conjugation system undergoes PE lipidation to drive autophagosome biogenesis; selective receptor NBR1 tethers polyubiquitinated protein aggregates and damaged organelles for vacuolar degradation.
Specific Molecular Players: ATG8 (GbATG8 / MAP1LC3B), NBR1 (p62 / SQSTM1), Bafilomycin A1, SlGB1
Primary Limitation: Macroautophagy kinetics validated in annual stress models; direct multi-decade autophagic flux measurements in ancient woody tissues are lacking.
Unresolved Research Gap: Whether long-lived woody perennials maintain sustained autophagic flux across centuries to prevent the age-related proteostatic collapse seen in shorter-lived organisms.
Verification Status & Method: Verified in sources; expression levels of ATG8 and NBR1 homologs mapped across age-cohort single-nuclei matrices.
Human Cellular Aging Parallel: MAP1LC3B (LC3B) and p62/SQSTM1 mediated macroautophagy clearing cytotoxic aggregates in human stem cells to prevent exhaustion.

Primary Limitation: Antioxidant cascades documented under acute abiotic stress; centenarian meristematic ROS levels across centuries require direct longitudinal measurement.
Unresolved Research Gap: Whether centenarian trees possess inherently elevated baseline expression or compartmentalization of ROS scavenging enzymes in cambial stem niches.
Verification Status & Method: Verified in sources; audited antioxidant and chaperone gene expression levels (SOD, CAT, APX, HSP70, HSP90) in dataset summaries.
